title: Reaction–diffusion linear stability
problem: On a bounded connected smooth Ω with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions consider u_t=d₁Δu+a u-b v, v_t=d₂Δv+c u-e v, where d₁,d₂,b,c,e>0 and a∈ℝ. Expand in Neumann Laplacian modes μₖ≥0 and derive a necessary and sufficient criterion for exponential linear stability in L² in terms of the trace and determinant of each 2×2 mode matrix. Address the high-mode tail.

offline_scenario.literature_notes: Fixture: Neumann spectral decomposition and the 2×2 Routh–Hurwitz criterion.

methods.name: Mode-by-mode spectral criterion
methods.rationale: Diagonalize spatial modes and check each 2×2 matrix.

steps.goal: Derive the mode matrix and characteristic polynomial

methods.name: Direct energy estimate
methods.rationale: Try a coercive quadratic energy; this fixture injects a failed step.
